state.context:
The objective is executable Can ownership of every scenario and judgment currently represented by manolea-2/tests, including faithful uploaded-site assets and updated documentation. This planning-only round must name aggressive deletion, paired dependencies and accepted risks; no source deletion or implementation is permitted. The previous 143-task apparatus maps Can's own 224 files/292 rows and has no actual Manolea replacement. Default removal covers the old plans/evidence/tools, all native-can source/campaigns/bootstrap, owner/reference/schema services, test-support ports and exclusive compiler adapters. A committed P04-manifest is read by bootstrap/reference; deleting both removes that live dependency. Shared emitter code unconditionally imports runtime/test-support; deleting adapters requires removing its wiring, catalogue operation entries, module index entries and regenerating official mirrors. Compiler driver stage/reuse/launch/lease code only serves the old test framework. Baseline native AI declaration support, runtime owner-core and ordinary assertions remain production dependencies; they are distinct from the extra test owner. The existing ordinary SQLite, HTTP/fetch, files, process and server operations already lower to native Bun/JavaScript. Narrow gaps concern running service handles, real filesystem edge facts and Playwright automation. The test DB service is an in-memory observer, not a query of actual Manolea SQLite.
The original probes assume trusted test code/operator-owned roots, require real independent observations, deliberate-defect refusal and reliable resource cleanup. Hard Mac storage/load constraints remain. A cooperative bounded local runner cannot promise hard RSS/tmp containment against hostile processes. Current P13/P14/P23 strict acceptance is a contract of the old framework; no inspected Manolea obligation requires its whole R/N/C/S/A identity hierarchy. Useful findings came from inventory/source consistency, semantic vectors, and real lifecycle controls; per-row cloned tables and prose cannot establish product behavior. No measured historical percentage or control-hours is available. Keep three specimen links to pinned Git objects, not copied archives. Commit coherent changes early. A small timer/cost record with fixed ceilings can prevent another proof ladder; it should not become a new management application.

architecture.instructions: Which replacement execution boundary best serves the actual tests while stating the isolation tradeoff?

criteria.minimal_native: Replace the old framework contract explicitly with a bounded trusted local runner using existing native Bun/JavaScript operations and only necessary typed adapters; Can keeps every scenario/verdict, cleanup and independent checks; disclose lack of hostile RSS/tmp containment.
criteria.strict_framework: Retain and finish the full reference/owner identity scheme plus strict host qualification before Manolea can progress; accept unknown host unblock and additional serial framework implementation.
criteria.wrapper: Move host probe code outside tests and invoke it from Can; host code keeps scenarios and judgments, with cheap directory cleanup but incomplete Can replacement.

removal.instructions: How should historical artifacts and dependency-bound deletions be handled?

criteria.closed_cut: Remove the enumerated legacy layers with all paired source/import/catalogue fixes, preserving specimen Git references and three provenance examples without separate archive copies.
criteria.rehome_all: Rename or relocate the full old plan and testing machinery into product directories, preserving its APIs and gates as mandatory prerequisites.
criteria.blind_delete: Delete only the large files/directories immediately, leaving callers, unconditional imports and P04 manifest reads to fail until later.

controls.instructions: What assurance stopping rule should govern each changed real test boundary?

criteria.minimal_actual: Require real independent results, one relevant deliberate defect, required-check completeness and cleanup; share one family receipt and source identities, then stop adding proof layers.
criteria.ladder: Continue per-row clone audits, detailed prose, per-slice review, new gates over gates and repeated re-review until every legacy apparatus count closes.
criteria.skip: Retire old probes using only typechecking and synthetic constant comparisons, without live subjects or failure/cleanup controls.
